entries.title: Blight in the Fields
entries.text: A grey rot runs through the grain of {province}. The reeve asks what to do about the winter.

entries.title: Bandits on the Road
entries.text: Armed bands are stopping carts outside {province}. Merchants talk of paying someone else to guard the road.

entries.title: A Scholar's Petition
entries.text: A travelling annotator offers a trunk of marked-up treatises in exchange for a stipend. The marginalia are excellent.

entries.title: A Generous Tide
entries.text: The pans at {province} filled overnight, as if the sea had remembered something.

entries.title: Unpaid Arrears
entries.text: Your sergeants report grumbling in the ranks. Several companies have not seen their pay in a long while.

options.label: Make an example
options.hint: lose a unit, +4 unrest at home

entries.title: A Border Argument
entries.text: Surveyors of {other} have moved a boundary stone by a hand's breadth. Both sides have scribes who can prove they were right first.

options.label: Apologise and pay for the stone

entries.title: The Feast of Hours
entries.text: Your calendar says today is a feast. Nobody else's does. The cooks are ready anyway.

entries.title: Fever in the Low Streets
entries.text: A wet fever has taken hold in {province}. Physicians disagree on everything except that it is spreading.

entries.title: A Forgotten Cache
entries.text: Diggers near {province} broke into a sealed room full of wrapped bars and boxed papers.

entries.title: The River Rises
entries.text: Snowmelt has brought the river over its banks at {province}. The low fields are already under water.

entries.title: A Wandering Company
entries.text: A company of sellswords has set up a camp on your road and sent word that their price is reasonable.

entries.title: The Calendar Schism
entries.text: Another house has declared your year to be eleven days short. Your archivists have noticed and are livid.
